movie.title: Wings of Dread
movie.overview: Air police officer Gu Chaoyang encounters a hijacking crisis on his flight back to China. With his extremely high professional ethics, he fights desperately to stop the hijacker, and a life-and-death struggle that takes place at an altitude of ten thousand meters begins.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: While flying back to China, air police officer Gu Chaoyang must rely on his tactical expertise and high professional ethics to thwart a violent hijacking ten thousand meters in the air.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Air police officer Gu Chaoyang finds his journey home suddenly interrupted when a group of ruthless hijackers takes control of his commercial flight. Trapped at ten thousand meters, Gu steps up to protect the innocent passengers and crew on board. Relying on his sharp instincts, unwavering duty, and physical prowess, he engages in a high-stakes battle of wits and strength against the perpetrators. His desperate fight becomes a pulse-pounding struggle to bring the aircraft safely down to earth.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Air police officer Gu Chaoyang is returning to China on what should be a routine commercial flight, looking forward to landing back on home soil. However, the flight turns into a living nightmare when a team of armed hijackers suddenly initiates a hostile takeover mid-flight. Trapped at an altitude of ten thousand meters with nowhere to run, the terrorized passengers look for hope as panic swiftly spreads through the cabin. Driven by an unshakeable sense of professional ethics and duty, Gu Chaoyang secretly mobilizes to assess the threat and neutralize the danger. Operating in tight, claustrophobic quarters, he uses tactical ingenuity, stealth, and lethal hand-to-hand combat to dismantle the hijackers one by one. Each confrontation escalates the stakes, forcing Gu to balance his own survival against the urgent need to keep innocent civilians unharmed. As the hijackers realize an operative is working against them, they raise the pressure, placing the entire plane in catastrophic peril. With fuel running low and time rapidly expiring, Gu Chaoyang faces off in a climactic life-and-death struggle against the remaining threats. Ultimately, his courage and relentless drive determine whether the flight reaches its destination or ends in total tragedy.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Wings of Dread is an edge-of-your-seat airborne thriller centered around Gu Chaoyang, an air police officer who finds himself in the eye of a terrifying storm during an international flight back to China. When a hijacking crisis erupts at ten thousand meters, the cabin becomes a pressure cooker of tension, fear, and high-altitude conflict. Dedicated to protecting human life above all else, Gu Chaoyang leaps into action to execute a daring counter-plan right under the hijackers' noses. Combining intense action, dramatic tension, and crime thriller elements, the story highlights the courage of a lone officer standing between innocent lives and absolute devastation.
